project.name: Balmirmer
project.boundarySource: Mapped named-place location with a conservative editorial study buffer
project.researchNotes: Full strict-boundary audit: zero local listed buildings and two local NRHE records. Both records have defensible broad material periods and remain visible without dates being appended to their names. No neighbouring attraction value is borrowed. Angus-wide full audit completed 2026-09-01: all six visitor categories, the four named commercial trail providers, current official/conventional routes, strict-boundary scoring and local HES/NRHE integrity were checked.

touristAppeal.label: Selector only
touristAppeal.summary: Balmirmer is a very small rural hamlet with two archaeological records but no verified visitor attraction, café, promoted trail, picnic site, public parking or public toilet. It remains in the selector for completeness and does not appear on the main map.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: No specific visitor dog-access offer was identified.

townStudyArea.sourceName: Mapped named-place location with a conservative editorial study buffer
townStudyArea.notes: Balmirmer has no separate NRS locality polygon in the reference dataset. The published editorial boundary is therefore the strict heritage study area; the 500 m ring is context only.

townGuide.headline: A catalogue locality rather than a visitor destination
townGuide.intro: Balmirmer scores 18% and remains selector-only. Its two local archaeology records are retained and dated, but no independent visitor experience or practical infrastructure was verified.
